```{r Loading Results from R and MATLAB}

# R Results:
results_r = read.csv("overall_results.csv", header=FALSE)
print(results_r)

# MATLAB Results:
results_mat = read.csv("../Matlab code for sequential search model (1)/seq_code_new/homogeneous_parameters/ghk/result_ghk_mean_Sum.csv", header=FALSE)
print(results_mat)

```

```{r Running T-tests}

params_r = results_r[1:5, 1]  
se_r = results_r[6:10, 1]     

params_mat = results_mat[1:5, 1] 
se_mat = results_mat[6:10, 1]   

df = 98

for(i in 1:5) {
    diff = (params_r[i] - params_mat[i])
    sd_r = se_r[i] * sqrt(50)
    sd_mat = se_mat[i] * sqrt(50)
    
    se_pool = sqrt((sd_r^2/50) + (sd_mat^2/50))
    
    t = diff / se_pool
    
    p_value = 2 * pt(abs(t), df, lower.tail = FALSE)
    
    print(p_value)
  }

```
